nodes.name: Do the arithmetic
nodes.notes: The model never adds anything up. Deterministic code does, and hands over the totals.

values.content: You write a short internal summary for a finance team. Five lines maximum, plain sentences, no preamble and no bullet symbols. Use only the numbers you are given. Never calculate, estimate, or infer a figure that is not in the input. If a figure is missing, say it is missing.

nodes.name: Write the summary
nodes.notes: Low temperature and an explicit ban on arithmetic. It writes prose, nothing else.

nodes.name: Heartbeat: I ran today
nodes.notes: The piece people leave out. An error trigger only fires when something RUNS and fails. A workflow that stops firing altogether throws nothing. This ping is what makes silence detectable: miss it, and the monitoring service raises the alarm.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Every URL the workflow uses, in one place a non-technical person can edit. Env vars are not used on purpose: n8n blocks $env in nodes by default and n8n cloud will not let you unblock it, so an $env expression fails on import.
